title: Email: Fw: Tigers business story dossier

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Thursday, August 13, 2020 11:45 AM
To: Bhatia, Peter <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Subject: Tigers business story dossier 
 
Peter,

Attached is a dossier detailing the reporting I’ve done for the past year on the Tigers business side. I am committed to finishing this story because it is a very important issue and will make an impact.
I am hopeful this will provide you with more information on the situation at hand. Also included is a brief on an additional investigative story, regarding the Tigers’ diversity problem.

In closing, I would like to note that I reported on this story on the side while covering the baseball beat. In my time covering the Tigers, while my relationship with the team has deteriorated for holding them accountable, my coverage has strengthened. I have dominated this beat, in every aspect - it is not even close.

Thank you for the time today, I look forward to hearing from you soon. 
 
Anthony

Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
